scope: Root real CUA browser UI on synthetic QA only; no mocks

tasks.prompt:
Extract only the garment from Image 1, not its background; present it alone on a pure white (#FFFFFF) seamless background as a centered, complete front-view flat-lay product photograph, with soft lighting and a subtle natural shadow. Remove any person, hanger or mannequin. Keep everything already established in Image 1: cream (#F2E6CE) color, sleeveless silhouette, exact V-neck depth, ribbed neckline, armholes and hem, visible knit stitches, softly textured yarn and plain, unpatterned surface. Keep the garment unchanged, with no buttons or pockets and no cropping.
Avoid: garment design or color changes, cropped garment, buttons or pockets, text, logos or watermarks, collages or multi-panel layouts, color swatches or dimension annotations, extra hands or distorted limbs, underage models, nudity or sexualization.

tasks.prompt:
Recolor all fabric in Image 1 to navy blue (#1B2A41), including neckline, armhole and hem ribbing; retain its design, not its cream color. Keep everything already established in Image 1: V-neck depth, sleeveless silhouette, construction lines, stockinette texture, ribbing, solid pattern, folds, highlights, shadows, white (#FFFFFF) background, and complete centered front view. Preserve the absence of buttons and pockets. The new color sits naturally in the fabric weave and folds, with realistic highlights and shadows, not a flat fill.
Avoid: garment structure or pattern changes, added buttons or pockets, flat color fill, background recoloring, cropped garment or collage grids, logos, watermarks or unrelated text, color swatches or dimension annotations, people, extra limbs, minors or sexualized nudity.
